title: Query count of the depth-two completion tree
statement: Let the alphabet be $\{\pm1\}$, choose a block and a seed from a three-element set, choose a known sign, and let $x\in\{\pm1\}^9$. The depth-two completion decision tree queries exactly one coordinate if the known sign equals the value of the chosen block of $x$ at the cyclic second coordinate determined by the seed, and exactly two coordinates otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: input $x$ is a sign vector of length $9$
